title: MED+250 production Turnstile positive-path test
summary: Owner-ready controlled test record for the real production Turnstile widget. Missing and invalid evidence are already rejected, but the valid-widget identity creation and complete cleanup path still require a browser operator.

checks.name: Missing Turnstile evidence rejected
checks.detail: The existing controlled security test records that a missing Turnstile response is rejected without changing the aggregate Auth user count.

checks.name: Invalid Turnstile evidence rejected
checks.detail: The existing controlled security test records that an invalid Turnstile response is rejected without changing the aggregate Auth user count.

checks.name: Real production widget completed
checks.detail: An approved browser operator has not yet completed the real production widget and supplied its short-lived response only to the protected verifier process.

checks.name: Disposable anonymous identity created
checks.detail: The protected verifier has not yet proven that one valid production widget response creates exactly one disposable anonymous customer session.

checks.name: Disposable identity completely removed
checks.detail: The valid-path session revocation, Auth identity deletion and restoration of the aggregate pre-test user count remain unexecuted.

checks.name: No marketplace side effect
checks.detail: The operator must confirm that the controlled Auth test created no cart, availability request, pharmacy message, prescription or marketplace data row.

checks.name: Redacted verifier output retained
checks.detail: The final evidence must contain only the privacy-safe verifier result and must not contain the widget response, identity, session material or raw provider response.

completion_instructions: Complete the real production widget in a controlled browser without adding products or submitting an availability request.
Run npm run security:turnstile:verify -- --require-valid with the short-lived widget response and protected Supabase values supplied only through the operator process environment.
Confirm one disposable identity is created, its session is revoked, its Auth record is deleted, the aggregate user count is restored and no marketplace row or pharmacy contact is created.
Retain only the redacted verifier output, set every check to passed, add the executor, role and timezone-qualified start and completion timestamps, and set status to complete.
Validate the completed test strictly and add it to the launch registry only with its exact SHA-256 digest.
